# lumos_entitlement_deprovisioning_workflow (Resource)

Binds an `entitlement-deprovisioning` workflow to an entitlement, as the workflow that revokes it. Lumos can't empty this slot, so destroying this resource, or moving it to a different entitlement, even one not known until apply, fails the plan. To change the workflow, set `workflow_id` to a different one. To stop managing the binding without changing Lumos, use a `removed` block with `destroy = false`. Lumos refuses to delete a workflow while it's bound to an entitlement, so the entitlement can't be destroyed in the same pass as this binding and its workflow. Stop managing both with `removed` blocks first, then destroy the entitlement. The workflow stays in Lumos.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Makes an entitlement-deprovisioning workflow the one that revokes the
# entitlement. Lumos can't empty this slot: change it by setting workflow_id,
# and stop managing it with a removed block (see below).
resource "lumos_entitlement_deprovisioning_workflow" "this" {
  entitlement_id = lumos_entitlement.deploy_admin.id
  workflow_id    = lumos_workflow.revoke_admin.id
}

# Stop managing the binding without changing Lumos.
# removed {
#   from = lumos_entitlement_deprovisioning_workflow.this
#   lifecycle {
#     destroy = false
#   }
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entitlement_id` (String) The entitlement's ID, which `GET /v1/entitlements` and `GET /v1/apps/{app_uuid}/entitlements` return as `id`. Requires replacement if changed.
- `workflow_id` (String) UUID of the workflow to associate.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = lumos_entitlement_deprovisioning_workflow.this
  id = "<entitlement id>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import lumos_entitlement_deprovisioning_workflow.this "<entitlement id>"
```
